none: PAS LEIC-F4D9B7: Roman copper alloy nummus of Aurelian
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP AVRELIANVS AVG ; D/ IMP C AVRELIANVS P F AVG

Roman silvered copper-alloy radiate of Aurelian (AD 270-5), SOLI INVICTO, Sol and two captives, Serdica, AD 274. RIC V, pt 2, p. 299, cf. 308; Estiot (BN) p. 209, cf. 1018. The mintmark is not recorded by Estiot with the obverse legend IMP AVRELIANVS AVG; it is recorded with the obverse legend IMP C AVRELIANVS P F AVG (Estiot 1020)
